# Getting Started

## Prerequisites

- List required tools (runtimes, CLIs, accounts)

## Setup

```bash
git clone <repo-url>
cd project-name/<subdir>
cp .env.example .env
```

## Install

```bash
npm install
```

## Run

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:8787

## Test

```bash
npm test
```
